commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
EXPECTED=68a066f546eed8307447a3ee59562b88a19823ca
GW_SERIAL='40:4C:CA:5D:0A:00'
EMU_SERIAL='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
ZB_OFFSET=0x16e000
ZB_SIZE=0x8000
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$EXPECTED"
git checkout -B "$BRANCH" "$EXPECTED"
git reset --hard "$EXPECTED"
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null
resolve_port() { python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import sys,time
from serial.tools import list_ports
sn=sys.argv[1]; end=time.time()+15
while time.time()<end:
    m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==sn and p.vid==0x303A]
    if len(m)==1:
        print(m[0].device); raise SystemExit(0)
    time.sleep(.2)
raise SystemExit('identity mismatch for '+sn)
PY
}
GW_PORT=$(resolve_port "$GW_SERIAL"); EMU_PORT=$(resolve_port "$EMU_SERIAL"); test "$GW_PORT" != "$EMU_PORT"
echo GATEWAY_PORT=$GW_PORT SERIAL=$GW_SERIAL
echo EMULATOR_PORT=$EMU_PORT SERIAL=$EMU_SERIAL
for P in "$GW_PORT" "$EMU_PORT"; do if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1 && lsof "$P" >/tmp/c6_v22_holders 2>/dev/null; then echo PORT_BUSY=$P; cat /tmp/c6_v22_holders; exit 42; fi; done
idf.py build >/dev/null
GW_PORT=$(resolve_port "$GW_SERIAL"); idf.py -p "$GW_PORT" flash >/dev/null
cd tests/zigbee_device_emulator
rm -f sdkconfig sdkconfig.old; rm -rf build
idf.py set-target esp32c6 >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('sdkconfig'); s=p.read_text(); old='CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED=y'; new='# CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED is not set\nCONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_IAS_CONTACT=y'
if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit(f'mixed profile default count={s.count(old)}')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
idf.py reconfigure >/dev/null
idf.py build >/dev/null
EMU_PORT=$(resolve_port "$EMU_SERIAL"); idf.py -p "$EMU_PORT" flash >/dev/null
cd ../..
git checkout -- tests/zigbee_device_emulator/dependencies.lock 2>/dev/null || true
GW_PORT=$(resolve_port "$GW_SERIAL"); python -m esptool --chip esp32c6 -p "$GW_PORT" --before default_reset --after no_reset erase_region "$ZB_OFFSET" "$ZB_SIZE" >/dev/null
EMU_PORT=$(resolve_port "$EMU_SERIAL"); python -m esptool --chip esp32c6 -p "$EMU_PORT" --before default_reset --after no_reset erase_region "$ZB_OFFSET" "$ZB_SIZE" >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,threading,time,serial
from serial.tools import list_ports
GW_SN='40:4C:CA:5D:0A:00'; EMU_SN='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
def resolve(sn):
    end=time.time()+15
    while time.time()<end:
        m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==sn and p.vid==0x303A]
        if len(m)==1:return m[0].device
        time.sleep(.15)
    raise RuntimeError('cannot resolve '+sn)
def reset(sn,label):
    p=resolve(sn); print(f'{label}_PORT={p} SERIAL={sn}',flush=True)
    subprocess.run(['python','-m','esptool','--chip','esp32c6','-p',p,'--before','default_reset','--after','hard_reset','chip_id'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    return resolve(sn)
logs={'GW':[],'EMU':[]}; stop=threading.Event()
def reader(name,port):
    with serial.Serial(port,115200,timeout=.1) as s:
        while not stop.is_set():
            b=s.readline()
            if b:
                t=b.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip(); logs[name].append(t); print(name+': '+t,flush=True)
gw=reset(GW_SN,'RESET_GW_FRESH'); tg=threading.Thread(target=reader,args=('GW',gw),daemon=True); tg.start()
deadline=time.time()+30
while time.time()<deadline:
    low='\n'.join(logs['GW']).lower()
    if 'network formed' in low and 'permit join duration=180' in low: break
    time.sleep(.2)
else:
    stop.set(); tg.join(timeout=1); raise SystemExit('gateway formation/permit timeout')
emu=reset(EMU_SN,'RESET_EMU_FRESH'); te=threading.Thread(target=reader,args=('EMU',emu),daemon=True); te.start()
deadline=time.time()+100
while time.time()<deadline:
    gl='\n'.join(logs['GW']).lower(); el='\n'.join(logs['EMU']).lower()
    if ('ias enroll request ep=1 error=0' in el and 'ias enroll response success' in el and 'contact_open=0.000 bool' in gl and 'contact_open=1.000 bool' in gl):
        time.sleep(3); break
    time.sleep(.2)
stop.set(); tg.join(timeout=1); te.join(timeout=1)
g='\n'.join(logs['GW']); e='\n'.join(logs['EMU']); gl=g.lower(); el=e.lower()
panic_terms=['abort() was called','guru meditation',"panic'ed",'assert failed','task watchdog got triggered']
gp=[x for x in panic_terms if x in gl]; ep=[x for x in panic_terms if x in el]
desc=any('descriptor' in x.lower() and '0500' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
auth='zigbee_device_authorized' in gl
basic='manufacturer=c6lab' in gl and 'model=c6emuv20' in gl
cap=any('input available zigbee/' in x.lower() and 'read=0x00004000' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
zt_fail='ias zonetype read failed' in gl
local_zt='ias contact initialized zonetype=0x0015 zonestatus=0x0020' in el
queued='writable state changed ep=1 cluster=0x0500 attr=0x0010; queued' in el
action='roundtrip action ep=1 cluster=0x0500 attr=0x0010 sent=1' in el
enroll_req='ias enroll request ep=1 error=0' in el
enroll_rsp='ias enroll response success' in el and 'state_status=0x00' in el and 'id_status=0x00' in el
f='contact_open=0.000 bool' in gl; t='contact_open=1.000 bool' in gl
generic_ias_report_error='cluster=0x0500 attr=0x0002 error=5' in el
print('EVIDENCE_REMOTE_ZONETYPE_0x0015='+str(cap and not zt_fail))
print('EVIDENCE_CIE_EVENT_QUEUED='+str(queued))
print('EVIDENCE_CIE_ACTION_SENT='+str(action))
print('EVIDENCE_ENROLL_REQUEST='+str(enroll_req))
print('EVIDENCE_ENROLL_RESPONSE='+str(enroll_rsp))
print('EVIDENCE_CONTACT_OPEN_FALSE='+str(f))
print('EVIDENCE_CONTACT_OPEN_TRUE='+str(t))
print('EVIDENCE_GENERIC_IAS_REPORT_ERROR5='+str(generic_ias_report_error))
print('EVIDENCE_GW_PANIC='+str(gp)); print('EVIDENCE_EMU_PANIC='+str(ep))
required=[('network formed','network formed' in gl),('authorized',auth),('IAS descriptor',desc),('Basic',basic),('local ZoneType',local_zt),('remote ZoneType',cap and not zt_fail),('CIE queued',queued),('CIE action',action),('enroll request',enroll_req),('enroll response',enroll_rsp),('CONTACT_OPEN false',f),('CONTACT_OPEN true',t),('no generic IAS report error5',not generic_ias_report_error),('GW no panic',not gp),('EMU no panic',not ep)]
failed=[n for n,v in required if not v]
if failed:
    print('=== GW IAS ===')
    for x in logs['GW']:
        if any(k in x.lower() for k in ['descriptor','input available zigbee/','contact_open','ias ','panic','abort','guru']): print(x)
    print('=== EMU IAS ===')
    for x in logs['EMU']:
        if any(k in x.lower() for k in ['ias ','cluster=0x0500','roundtrip','tick=','panic','abort','guru']): print(x)
    raise SystemExit('E2E FAILED: '+', '.join(failed))
print('FRESH_NETWORK_DUAL_C6_IAS_E2E=PASS')
PY
git status --short
